scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:chrome: start "FarFlung Dev Server" cmd /k "npm run dev" & start "" chrome http://localhost:5173
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --ignore-scripts --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
